layouts.name: CAccent_AccentPolicy
layouts.notes: 28000.3231: UpdateAccentPolicy copies the 16-byte current policy here. ValidateVisual/IsAcrylicBlurEnabledAndAllowed/EnsureBackgroundVisual consume its state; EndTransition promotes the pending policy here.

layouts.name: CAccent_TransitionPolicy
layouts.notes: 28000.3231: UpdateAccentPolicy writes the pending policy before StartTransition. UpdateResources passes it to EnsureBackgroundVisual, UpdateTransitionGradient consumes its color, and EndTransition copies all 16 bytes into the current policy.

layouts.name: CAccent_BackgroundVisual
layouts.notes: 28000.3231: UpdateResources passes this owning pointer to EnsureBackgroundVisual before the transition layer. EndTransition removes/releases the old primary and promotes the pending visual; CleanupNonStaticsResources independently releases it.

layouts.name: CAccent_ParentVisible
layouts.notes: 28000.1 and 28000.3231 constructors initialize this flag to false. SetParentVisible independently writes it and marks acrylic resources dirty on a visible transition. _UpdateAcrylicBlurBehind requires it before configuring and attaching the background; native clone policy initialization already schedules that update.
